responsibility: Implements GCC’s <stdalign.h> wrapper for the C alignment facility by exporting the standard spellings alignas and alignof as macros to the core language operators _Alignas and _Alignof, and by defining the __alignas_is_defined and __alignof_is_defined feature macros when required by the language mode. It is responsible for exposing source-level alignment syntax compatibility, especially across pre-C23 C and non-C++ modes.
